proposals.observation: The Daily Blog Post workflow failed at 06:00 on 2026-08-05. There is only 1 post queued against 47 published. If the workflow stays broken, the queue empties today and the site goes dark on new content. The Funnel-Hack Digest workflow also failed at 11:06 the same day, and Fred Propose failed the previous evening. Three consecutive CI failures across different workflow files points to a shared dependency — most likely an expired API key or a broken import in a shared utility the workflows call.
proposals.proposal: Inspect the Daily Blog Post workflow log for the root error message. If it is an authentication failure (HTTP 401 or similar), rotate the relevant API key and update the corresponding GitHub Actions secret. If it is a missing import or a Node version mismatch, patch the offending line. Fixing this one workflow likely resolves the Funnel-Hack Digest failure too, because both died within the same five-hour window and Fred Propose failed the night before — sequential cascade from a single broken dependency is the most probable cause. This is the highest-leverage fix available: without it, Joel publishes nothing tomorrow through automated channels.

This is the entire funnel stalled at its first gate.

proposals.impact: lifts open rate from 37.5% toward the 52-66% range seen in the other two sequences
proposals.observation: The Money Worship automation has a 37.5% open rate across 16 sends. The Money Avoidance sequence sits at 52.6% and Money Vigilance at 66.7%. All three sequences serve people who completed the same quiz and share similar list quality, so the gap is almost certainly the subject line or preview text on email 1 of the Money Worship sequence, not list health. A 15-point open rate gap at this small send volume is meaningful and worth addressing before the list grows.
